room.subtitle: Your private retreat
room.title: The Room
room.description: Furnished with authentic pieces from rural tradition and refined finishes, our room offers sophisticated comfort without betraying the original spirit of the "grandmother's house". An intimate and quiet environment, designed to provide deep and restorative rest, far from the hectic daily pace.

house.subtitle: Shared spaces, timeless stories
house.title: The House
house.description: The property preserves the charm of ancient Piedmontese farmhouses, featuring solid stone and exposed brick architecture. The spacious common areas and flower-filled courtyard are designed for sharing moments of authentic conviviality, from the first light of breakfast to a glass of wine at sunset.
house.quote: An architecture that breathes together with the surrounding vineyards, designed to slow down time.

aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.description: My family and I warmly welcome you to our historic retreat in the heart of Monferrato, offering an authentic experience immersed among the rolling hills, where history, nature and culture blend harmoniously.

montemagno.subtitle: The almond-shaped village
montemagno.title: Montemagno
montemagno.description: Perched on the hill, Montemagno is a unique medieval village, famous for its distinctive almond-shaped urban layout and its twelve historic alleys. Walking through its streets means stepping back in time, admiring the imposing crenellated castle that silently dominates the surrounding valley.

monferrato.subtitle: UNESCO World Heritage
monferrato.title: Il Monferrato
monferrato.description: An endless expanse of hills combed by vineyards. Monferrato is a generous land that offers unique gastronomic and wine excellences and villages rich in history. An authentic landscape to get lost in, where colours change with the seasons and offer unforgettable sunsets.

breakfast.subtitle: Morning tastes authentic here
breakfast.title: Garden Breakfast
breakfast.description: Start your day immersed in the greenery of our park, where the scent of coffee blends with the fresh morning air. Our breakfast celebrates the territory with a careful selection of homemade cakes and tarts, artisan bread, fresh seasonal fruit and local zero-kilometre delights, designed to give you a sweet and rejuvenating awakening.

hero.subtitle: Spaces and atmospheres
hero.title: The House
hero.tagline: A brick farmhouse where time slows down

intro.title: A house that tells the story of Monferrato
intro.body: Il Respiro del Borgo was born from the careful restoration of an old Piedmontese farmhouse, where every stone, every beam and every exposed brick holds the memory of rural life. We restored the rooms with respect, preserving the original soul of the "grandmother's house" and enriching it with discreet modern comfort. The result is an intimate, warm and bright home, designed to make you feel at home from your very first step.
intro.quote: Here the walls breathe together with the vineyards: we simply reopened the windows onto time.

house.subtitle: Outdoor living, unhurried days
house.title: The Outdoor Spaces
house.description: Here, the best moments happen outdoors. The panoramic veranda is our bright living room: wrapped in large windows that frame the vineyards, it welcomes slow mornings over coffee and long, unhurried afternoons in the light. Just beyond, the garden opens onto the rolling hills — a peaceful corner to breathe deeply, read in the shade and let time stretch out. Two spaces shaped by greenery, natural light and quiet care, designed for guests who come to the Monferrato in search of calm, nature and a genuine sense of wellbeing.

room.subtitle: Your private retreat
room.title: The Room
room.description: The room is a quiet, intimate nest, furnished with authentic pieces of rural tradition and finishes cared for down to the smallest detail. It can be arranged to host a couple in a double bed or two guests in single beds, dressed in natural linen and cotton for a deep, restful sleep; the windows open onto the hills and let in the first light of morning. The bright en-suite bathroom is finished in period tiles, and a private entrance ensures freedom and tranquillity, in a space designed for two.

cta.title: Come and experience it yourself
cta.body: Our room is ready to welcome you. Write to us to check availability and treat yourself to a few days of authentic breathing space in Monferrato.

hero.subtitle: The territory
hero.title: The Surroundings
hero.tagline: Among the UNESCO World Heritage hills of Monferrato

intro.title: In the heart of the Monferrato hills
intro.body: Il Respiro del Borgo lies in Montemagno, a small medieval village set among the vineyards of the Asti Monferrato, recognised as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. This is a land of gentle hills, historic cellars and generous tables, where every season paints the landscape in different colours. From here begin walks, wine roads and art itineraries that reveal an authentic Piedmont, still pleasantly uncrowded.
intro.quote: A landscape that changes colour with every hour, and never stops surprising you.

montemagno.subtitle: The almond-shaped village
montemagno.title: Montemagno
montemagno.description: Perched on the hill, Montemagno is a unique village, famous for its distinctive almond-shaped urban layout and its twelve historic alleys. A monumental staircase leads up to the parish church and the imposing castle that dominates the valley. Walking through these streets means stepping back in time, among quiet glimpses and panoramas that open onto the vineyards. The house sits right in the village, just a few steps from everything.

monferrato.subtitle: UNESCO World Heritage
monferrato.title: Il Monferrato
monferrato.description: An endless expanse of hills combed by vineyards, Monferrato is a generous land that offers gastronomic and wine excellences known the world over: from Barbera to Grignolino, from truffles to farmhouse cheeses. Between one village and the next you'll find welcoming cellars, Romanesque churches and the "Infernot", small cellars carved into the local sandstone, also a UNESCO heritage. A territory to be enjoyed slowly, glass after glass.

wine.title: Cellars & wine
wine.text: Visits and tastings in family-run wineries, between Barbera, Grignolino and Ruché. We'll point you to the producers we love most.

walks.title: Walks & cycling
walks.text: Trails through the vineyards and white gravel roads, perfect for walks, e-bikes and sunset rides from one hill to the next.

food.title: Local flavours
food.text: Trattorias and farm restaurants serving agnolotti, bagna càuda and Monferrato truffles, paired with local wines.

culture.title: Art & castles
culture.text: Castles, Romanesque churches and medieval villages just minutes away by car, for lovers of history, art and photogenic views.

cta.title: Let us guide you through the hills
cta.body: When you arrive, we'll be glad to suggest itineraries, cellars and tables tailored to you. Write to us and let's start imagining your stay together.

hero.tagline: Small daily touches, with the heart of a home

intro.title: Everything that makes your stay easy
intro.body: We believe in a hospitality made of sincere gestures rather than formalities. That's why we've thought of everything that can make your stay comfortable and serene, leaving you free to enjoy the silence of the hills. Some services are always included, others we're happy to arrange on request: just ask.

breakfast.subtitle: Morning tastes authentic here
breakfast.title: Garden Breakfast
breakfast.description: The day begins at the table, in the greenery of our garden or in the common room on cooler mornings. Every breakfast is prepared with care: homemade cakes and tarts, artisan bread, seasonal jams, fresh fruit and local zero-kilometre products. The coffee is always freshly brewed espresso, because here a good morning smells of something real.

intro.body: We'll be glad to answer any question and to help you organise your stay. Write or call us: behind Il Respiro del Borgo there is a family, not a switchboard.

directions.title: How to reach us

car.title: By car
car.text: From the A21 Turin–Piacenza motorway, take the Asti Est exit, then follow the signs for Montemagno (about 20 minutes). Free private parking on site.

train.title: By train
train.text: Asti station, on the Turin–Genoa–Milan line, about 20 km away. From there Montemagno is reached by car or by transfer on request.

plane.title: By plane
plane.text: Turin Caselle (~70 km), Milan Malpensa and Genoa (~110 km) airports. A rental car is recommended to explore the hills.

directions.note: We'll send you detailed directions and the exact location once your booking is confirmed.

policy.title: Privacy & Cookie Policy
policy.intro: This website is designed to respect your privacy and collects as little data as possible. Here is everything you need to know:

points.storage: The site saves your preferred language directly in your browser (localStorage and a technical cookie), so you don't have to select it again on every visit.
points.local: This data is NOT sent to external servers or shared with third parties: it stays solely on your device.
points.purpose: It is used only to show you the site in the correct language on your future visits.
points.retention: It is kept until you clear your browser data; the technical cookie automatically expires after one year.
points.noConsent: As this is a technical piece of data necessary for the site to work, it does not require your prior consent under the ePrivacy regulations.
